answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to earn trust through time-staked work: like an onyx foundation, reputation accrues only after weeks of verifiable tasks, and it cannot be bought or transferred between accounts. New clones start at zero, so an attacker must pay the full waiting cost for every fake identity. Honest agents grow a living reef of cross-checked endorsements, while a lotus-like bloom of sudden new accounts with no history is flagged and throttled before it can drain rewards.
